prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: revised high-fidelity Chinese desktop application import screen.
Input image 1: edit target and visual-style reference. Update its import workflow while preserving its AstroToo header, light Windows app style, pale cool gray/white panels, royal blue actions, fine borders, rounded corners, sidebar, device context, same-LAN reminder, typography and two-step flow.
Primary request: ONE UNIFIED FILE PICKER FOR BOTH PHOTOS AND VIDEOS. Completely REMOVE the "照片 · 可多选" and "视频 · 每次 1 个" tabs. No media-category selector, no Photos/Videos navigation, no media-type filter, no mode switch. All photo and video files are visible together in the same gallery. Media type is inferred automatically from selected files.

Composition: ONE complete flat front-facing desktop app window, landscape around 1600x1000. Product title "AstroToo", language "简体中文", device "AstroToo · 480 × 480". Main title "导入照片和视频". Subtitle "选择本地文件，上传到当前设备". Stepper "1 选择文件" active, "2 裁剪与上传" inactive. Sidebar active item is "导入文件". Keep the LAN reminder.
Source row folder icon, "旅行回忆", neutral folder path "C:\照片\旅行回忆", button "选择文件…".
Preserve ONLY the UPLOAD-STATUS segmented filter "仅未上传" active / "全部" inactive, label "上传状态". Helper "只过滤已确认上传至当前设备的文件". Summary "找到 12 个文件，已隐藏 4 个已上传文件". The status filter is NOT a media-type switch.
Gallery: 8 files, 4 columns × 2 rows, mixed photos and videos in one grid. Exactly ONE selected video tile, blue border and checked upper-left checkbox, filename "海边旅行.mp4", natural coastline still with small video/duration badge "03:24". All other 7 tiles are UNSELECTED: 6 pleasant photo thumbnails (landscapes, dog, flowers) with .jpg filenames, plus another unselected video with duration "00:28". Unselected files retain visible images; no extra checkmarks, no mixed selected batch. Toolbar "已选 1 个文件" and small "清空选择". Do not show "全选" in this selected-video state.
IMPORTANT: place the selection-rule explanation BELOW the gallery, NOT above as a photo/video category or a huge warning banner. A compact, clearly readable pale-blue information strip:
"照片可多选；选择视频时，每次只能选择 1 个文件，最长 30 分钟。"
Below or alongside in smaller text for the shown selected-video state:
"已选择视频，取消选择后可多选照片。"
Sticky footer left "已选 1 个视频", gray "取消", primary blue "下一步：裁剪". No separate next-photo or next-video entry.
Interaction invariants: Selecting only photos permits multi-select; selecting a video restricts this import to that one file. Users never preselect a media category. Clearing the selected video restores photo multi-select. Existing crop step still supports individual photo editing or applying the first crop to remaining photos, but do not show crop controls on this picker.
Constraints: exact legible Chinese, tasteful realistic photo content, no invented controls, no perspective, watermark, device renders, codecs or protocol names. Keep existing visual style and remove the category tabs decisively.
interactionRules: 统一展示照片和视频，使用一个选择文件入口，无照片/视频分类切换。
仅选择照片时允许多选；选中视频时本次只允许该一个文件。
选择区下方持续显示规则，选中视频时说明取消选择后可多选照片。
保留仅未上传/全部状态筛选，并按当前设备判断。
批量照片逐张裁剪或沿用第一张的设计保留。
